reuse.why: New guards live in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank and every provider calls prepareBankAccountLink, but the new linkBankSyncAccount is used only by GoCardless and Fintegra, and replaceExistingAccountLink re-writes the unlink update that unlinkAccount already performs.

duplication.why: The step-0 refactor is left incomplete: SimpleFin, PluggyAi, Akahu and EnableBanking keep their own upgrade-or-create, payee, syncAccount and sync-event blocks; replaceExistingAccountLink repeats ensureAccountIsNotLinked's lookup query and unlinkAccount's column-nulling update; downloadFintegraTransactions is a near copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Link validation helpers go in accounts/link.ts, the orchestration in accounts/app.ts, the download in accounts/sync.ts and the server URL in server-config, which matches the tree's layering.

scope.why: Changes follow the five steps; widening DbAccount['account_sync_source'] to all providers is a small adjacent fix needed by the shared helper's typing.

maintainability.why: Two of six providers go through the shared link definition and four still carry their own copies, so a future change to linking (the stated goal of step 0) still has to be made in five places, and the unlink and lookup logic now exist twice each.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount in accounts/app.ts do not use linkBankSyncAccount; replaceExistingAccountLink in link.ts re-implements the unlink update instead of sharing it with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: replaceExistingAccountLink reformats ensureAccountIsNotLinked's SELECT on one line and copies unlinkAccount's null-out update; downloadFintegraTransactions trims downloadAkahuTransactions rather than sharing a generic download.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink takes a replaceExistingLink flag with an if/else between replaceExistingAccountLink and ensureAccountIsNotLinked (and LinkAccountBaseParams gained the flag); linkBankSyncAccount carries fileId and eventTables options, while four provider link functions bypass it.
